<document id="plan-premium">
TheˆPremiumˆplanˆPremiumˆcostsˆ$15.00ˆaˆmonth.ˆItˆremovesˆnearlyˆeveryˆfeeˆweˆcharge,ˆcomesˆwithˆaˆmetalˆcard,ˆandˆhasˆtheˆhighestˆlimitsˆandˆsavingsˆrateˆweˆoffer.ˆ##ˆWhat'sˆincludedˆ-ˆ**Monthlyˆfee:**ˆ$15.00ˆ-ˆ**ATMs:**ˆnoˆTallowbrookˆfeeˆatˆanyˆATMˆinˆtheˆUS,ˆandˆweˆreimburseˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆaˆmonth.ˆ-ˆ**Foreignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆ0%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆ-ˆ**Cardˆreplacement:**ˆfreeˆ-ˆ**Expeditedˆcardˆshipping:**ˆfreeˆ-ˆ**SavingsˆPockets:**ˆ3.75%ˆAPYˆ-ˆ**Cushion:**ˆfee-freeˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$200ˆonˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆ-ˆ**Dailyˆcardˆspendingˆlimit:**ˆ$10,000ˆ-ˆ**DailyˆATMˆlimit:**ˆ$1,500ˆ##ˆGoodˆtoˆknowˆPremiumˆmembersˆcanˆgetˆanˆemergencyˆreplacementˆcardˆdeliveredˆabroadˆwithinˆ3ˆbusinessˆdaysˆatˆnoˆcost.ˆYourˆcardˆisˆmetal,ˆandˆreplacementsˆareˆmetalˆtoo.ˆYouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆanyˆtimeˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPlan.ˆUpgradesˆstartˆrightˆaway.ˆDowngradesˆstartˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="fees-all-v2">
FeesˆforˆallˆplansˆThisˆisˆtheˆfullˆfeeˆscheduleˆforˆallˆthreeˆplans,ˆeffectiveˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆMonthlyˆfeeˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ$5.00ˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$2.50ˆ|ˆ$2.50ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆForeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆ|ˆ3%ˆ|ˆ1%ˆ|ˆ0%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCardˆreplacementˆ|ˆ$5.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆcardˆshippingˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆ$35.00ˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositˆatˆaˆretailˆstoreˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ##ˆNotesˆ-ˆPlusˆincludesˆ3ˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆeachˆcalendarˆmonth.ˆTheˆfeeˆinˆtheˆtableˆappliesˆafterˆthose.ˆ-ˆPremiumˆreimbursesˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆaˆmonth.ˆ-ˆThereˆareˆnoˆoverdraftˆfeesˆ($0.00),ˆnoˆfeesˆforˆreturnedˆtransfersˆandˆnoˆinactivityˆfeesˆonˆanyˆplan.ˆ-ˆIncomingˆdomesticˆwiresˆareˆfreeˆ($0.00)ˆonˆeveryˆplan.ˆ-ˆATMˆownersˆcanˆaddˆtheirˆownˆsurcharge.ˆThatˆisˆseparateˆfromˆourˆfee.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="support-complaints">
MakingˆaˆcomplaintˆIfˆyou'reˆunhappyˆwithˆsomethingˆwe'veˆdone,ˆtellˆus.ˆYouˆcanˆmakeˆaˆformalˆcomplaintˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆcomplainˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆsayˆyou'dˆlikeˆtoˆmakeˆaˆformalˆcomplaint.ˆTellˆusˆwhatˆhappenedˆandˆwhatˆyou'dˆlikeˆusˆtoˆdo.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆitˆtoˆourˆComplaintsˆteam.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆ-ˆWeˆacknowledgeˆyourˆcomplaintˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ-ˆWeˆsendˆaˆfinalˆresponseˆwithinˆ15ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆmoreˆtime,ˆforˆexampleˆbecauseˆwe'reˆwaitingˆonˆanotherˆbank,ˆwe'llˆtellˆyouˆwhyˆandˆwhenˆtoˆexpectˆanˆanswer.ˆ##ˆOurˆresponseˆTheˆfinalˆresponseˆexplainsˆwhatˆweˆfound,ˆwhatˆwe'llˆdo,ˆandˆyourˆoptionsˆifˆyou'reˆstillˆunhappy,ˆincludingˆwhereˆyouˆcanˆtakeˆyourˆcomplaintˆoutsideˆTallowbrook.ˆ##ˆLegalˆmattersˆIfˆyourˆmessageˆinvolvesˆlegalˆactionˆorˆaˆregulator,ˆsupportˆpassesˆitˆstraightˆtoˆtheˆComplaintsˆteam.ˆMakingˆaˆcomplaintˆneverˆaffectsˆhowˆweˆtreatˆyourˆaccount.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
